metadata.description: Overseer runs a PLAN.md through your Claude sessions. The workflow gate asks a human to approve each Workflow plan, in the browser or in the terminal.

plugins.name: overseer
plugins.description: /oversee runs the project's PLAN.md through the Claude sessions you pick: tasks, judging, weekly-limit budget, answers, nudges.

plugins.name: workflow-gate
plugins.description: Requires a human-approved plan before Claude Code's Workflow tool runs, plus the workflow-orchestration-patterns skill.

plugins.name: workflow-gate-terminal
plugins.description: workflow-gate in the terminal: see the plan, change the model and effort of each agent, approve, watch the run live, and learn from each run. Records approvals through the workflow-gate plugin.
